known_assets: Map 1 runtime wall/floor/stone source images remain the Wikimedia Commons materials recorded directly in visuals/spaces-lab/index.html.
Map 1 derives atlas.archBacking at runtime from the existing wall material and cuts an arch-shaped opening. No new external asset is required.
Map 2 uses procedural solid violet world-space materials rather than stretched image textures.
visuals/spaces-lab/assets/checker-grid.svg remains historical/optional and is not loaded by the current runtime.
rule: Reuse stable source materials when possible. Current lighting is procedural and world-space: each sampled point is lit strictly by Euclidean 3D distance from the camera center; tall structures are sampled densely near the base.
